title: Name Similarity Encourages Generosity: A Field Experiment in Email Personalization
authors: Kurt P. Munz; Minah H. Jung; Adam L. Alter
eligible_reason: Randomized email field experiment (DonorsChoose) varying whether the potential donor shares a surname with the teacher; cross-sectional logit/OLS of opening, clicking and donating on the name-match condition with demographic controls. No staggered adoption and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: Table1.txt-Table9.txt hold the R code and output, e.g. glm(diddonate ~ condition + raceMatch + genderMatch + ... , family=binomial). Regression inventory empty because code is stored in .txt output files.
data_files_note: Experiment data shipped (30,297 rows; some variables removed for anonymity); also posted at osf.io/9abev.
software_notes: SPSS for the published analysis; R code and output provided.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
